description:
You are a building commissioning engineer contracted to address persistent thermal comfort complaints in the L_Shape commercial office building. Occupants across all Basement (BB.*) conditioned zones consistently report overcooling in summer and insufficient heating in winter. After reviewing ASHRAE Standard 55 thermal comfort criteria and the building's occupancy profile, you recommend a setpoint adjustment strategy for the BB floor.

Your commissioning scope:
- For ALL conditioned zones on the Basement (BB.*) floor: raise the design cooling setpoint (DESIGN-COOL-T) from the current value to 77°F. This reduces overcooling and improves summer comfort.
- For ALL conditioned zones on the Basement (BB.*) floor: lower the design heating setpoint (DESIGN-HEAT-T) from the current value to 70°F. This corrects the winter underheating complaint.
- For ALL BB.* HVAC systems: reduce the supply duct static pressure (SUPPLY-STATIC) from the current value to 1.1 in. w.g. This right-sizes the fan pressure for the shorter duct runs in the basement, reducing fan energy.
- Run the full annual simulation to quantify the impact of the setpoint and fan energy changes on total building energy consumption.
- Save the project.

The L_Shape building model is already loaded. You must navigate the eQUEST Air-Side HVAC and Building Shell trees to find and modify all BB floor zones and systems. The exact count of BB floor zones and systems is not provided.
